title: Reason to Retrieve: Enhancing Query Understanding through Decomposition and Interpretation
reasoning: The paper focuses on information retrieval and query understanding. While it evaluates on a 'Theorem-based' subset of the BRIGHT benchmark (labeled as TheoQ and TheoT), this refers to logical and mathematical reasoning rather than theological or faith-based study. It does not contain an evaluation or benchmark related to religion, ethics, or morals.
